# UX Task Log

## [t7] Parity-preserving responsive UX and accessibility design

- Active-root routes remain primary; archived comparison, submission, editor, auth, and math routes are additive.
- Persona changes alter framing only and must never alter clinical evidence or deterministic results.
- Invisible parity includes route focus/scroll, dialog focus return, retained form input, fail-closed authorization, callback sanitation, and non-fabricated query failures.
- Explicit requirement IDs are required in the coverage matrix; grouped ranges initially hid traceability gaps.
- Reusable pattern: pair every chart/map/graph with a synchronized textual equivalent and preserve state across pointer and keyboard interaction.
- Learnings consumed: [(none)]
